description: Agent Inventory: submit a stock adjustment log with the count and the period close it answers to: the log with its reference, its first and last day, the day the period closed and each adjustment with its id, the item, location, the signed units (positive adds to stock on hand, negative removes from it), the stated reason, who entered it, the day entered and the day posted; optionally the count with its reference, its date, each person who took it and each count variance with the item, location and units counted less stock on hand. The signed report gives the log, each adjustment against a stated reason, the adjustments over the period read for direction, each hand that entered an adjustment against the people who took the count, and each posting date against the day the period closed, and counts them, and names a divergent adjustment log: an adjustment with no stated reason, adjustments that run in only one direction over the period, an adjustment entered by the same hand that took the count, and an adjustment posted after the period closed; then an adjustment that exactly cancels a count variance and an adjustment entered outside the log period, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No adjustments, fewer than three that move stock, no one named as taking the count, no hand named on an adjustment, or no close date leaves those points unverified. A reason that is blank or names nothing found, such as adjustment, misc or correction, reads as no reason; three or more adjustments that all add or all remove run one way; people match as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, items by their SKU or their words, units to the hundredth and dates by the day. This reads the changes made to the stock record after a count, for their reasons, their direction, the hands that made them and their timing. Verdict inventory_adjustment_divergent, inventory_adjustment_partial, inventory_adjustment_unverified or inventory_adjustment_consistent. POST /api/inventory-adjustment-check. Reads the inventory records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never moves stock, never places or cancels an order, never writes to anyone’s inventory system and never adjusts a record, which stay with the business and its staff, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Inventory reads inventory records: a stock count, receiving records, shrinkage and loss records, a stock adjustment log, an inventory valuation, reorder records, a dead stock record and consignment stock records, each against the system stock record, the purchase or consignment orders, the count and sales records, the count and the period close, the counts and purchase records, the stock levels and lead times, the movement window and period report, or the sale and settlement records it answers to. The family checks whether the stock record can be trusted; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the ledger the stock feeds, and the boutique tools act on one store’s orders. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-inventory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-inventory/.

variance.description: The units counted less the stock on hand.

quantity.description: The units adjusted: positive adds to stock on hand, negative removes from it.

period_start.description: The first day of the period.
